name: Kami
source:
"Isn't it because you didn't like the world I created?"

The God who created this world. He is the creator of all things, but he is not very interested in his creatoions.

He has a soft demeanor but a high pride as a God, making him unable to admit that the world he created was flawed.

[Translated from [url=http://dswtc.web.fc2.com/game/jinseikanojo/jinseikanojo.html]official website[/url]]
